clear-space.name: Clear space
clear-space.note: Nothing to hide behind and nothing to hide you.

asteroid-belt.name: Asteroid belt
asteroid-belt.note: Terrain to hide behind, and rocks that will find you.

nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.note: Hides you; ionizes everything you repair.

ice-field.name: Ice field
ice-field.note: Cold-stress on hull and seals; water for the plant.

dust-field.name: Dust field
dust-field.note: The best place to drift; the filters will hate you for it.

debris-field.name: Debris field
debris-field.note: Salvage to be had, if you will go outside for it.

radiation-storm.name: Radiation storm
radiation-storm.note: Floods the sensors and burns the watch.

ion-storm.name: Ion storm
ion-storm.note: Kills long-range traffic and boards alike.

gravity-well.name: Gravity well
gravity-well.note: Cheap to hide in, expensive to leave.
